newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers remain cautious.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers remain cautious.

text.p: Spinners in most European markets continued to cover raw material requirements cautiously despite the rather better tone recently in evidence in the yarn sector, industry sources said.

The buying interest seldom extended beyond the early months of 1997 and was confined mainly to Central Asian and African Franc Zone descriptions, though Syrian medium/better qualities also changed hands in Italy.
The long staple sector remained slow and no noteworthy new business was reported from Eastern Europe.
